title: Salmai the Netophathite
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: His sons are praised in Taanit 28a: once the government forbade bringing wood for the altar fire, but they cleverly brought it nevertheless. Of them the sages said, “The memory of the righteous is for a blessing.”[^1]

notes.text: The three complete Taanit 28a paragraphs name the sons of Salmai the Netophathite, explain the government’s wood prohibition and their use of ladders to carry wood past the guards, and apply the righteous-memory blessing to them and others like them. The heading and the plural sons are retained without supplying additional individual identities.
